subject.title: fix: harden cloud worker admission and remote turns

question: Has Crabbox v0.38.1 or newer been published through every supported install channel, and may this fail-closed cloud-worker upgrade be included now?
rationale: The patch intentionally makes older or unverifiable AWS setups unavailable, and the PR states that the currently published Crabbox release cannot satisfy its authoritative admission contract.

options.title: Publish, verify, then merge
options.body: Publish Crabbox v0.38.1+ everywhere operators obtain it, verify fresh and upgraded AWS workers, rebase this PR, and merge afterward.

options.title: Coordinate an intentional cutoff
options.body: Merge before full dependency availability only if maintainers explicitly accept temporary AWS worker outages and provide a coordinated operator upgrade path.

recommendation.title: Publish, verify, then merge
recommendation.body: Publish Crabbox v0.38.1+ everywhere operators obtain it, verify fresh and upgraded AWS workers, rebase this PR, and merge afterward.

likelyOwner.reason: Owns the cloud-worker design and this hardening series and is best positioned to confirm the cross-repository release sequence.
